initial_message: There's water damage along the shared wall between my unit and my neighbor's. I genuinely don't know where it started — it could be my own pipes behind that wall, or it could be a leak coming through from the neighbor's side. The drywall is soaked and the flooring is warped near the wall. Policy POL-1004.
note: STAND-OUT (break-on-purpose) fixture: origin is genuinely unknowable and the claimant returns NO_RESPONSE to any clarification, so the agent should escalate rather than route at low confidence.
